steps.title: Worksheet 13 bracket: extrude the base
actions: File > New > Standard (mm).ipt and save it as ws13_bracket.ipt.
Start 2D Sketch on the XY Plane. Draw a rectangle 100 wide and 120 deep.

steps.title: Worksheet 13 bracket: extrude the upright
actions: Start 2D Sketch on the side (YZ) plane. Draw the upright: 50 thick at the back of the base, up to 75, with an R25 arc on top centred 75 up.
Finish Sketch. Extrude: Distance 100, Join. OK.

steps.title: Worksheet 13 bracket: hole R10 through the upright
actions: Hole: Concentric with the R25 arc, diameter 20 (R10), Through All. OK.

steps.title: Worksheet 13 bracket: hole R7.5 in the base
actions: Hole: Placement = on the top of the base, 20 from the front and 20 from the right end, diameter 15 (R7.5), Through All. OK. Save.
steps.note: The worksheet drawing is first angle (the plan is below the front view), so the upright is at the back. Its R20 marks the hole position 20 from the corner: the pictorial view shows a square corner.
